user.title: Set up a wake-light room
user.description: Setup requires one explicit root light, explicit leaf targets, a fail-closed vacation entity, and a Presence Based Lighting control lease. Leave the legacy brightness lifecycle acknowledgement off until the conflicting automation is patched.

data.legacy_brightness_lifecycle_safe: Legacy brightness-255 lifecycle has been retired or patched

data_description.target_light_entity_ids: Select only the leaf lights Wake Light may own. Do not implicitly include every group member.
data_description.blocker_entity_ids: Every blocker must be exactly off. Include the room Adaptive Lighting switch.
data_description.legacy_brightness_lifecycle_safe: Leave this acknowledgement off until the existing full-brightness room lifecycle no longer races the Wake Light coordinator.

error.invalid_profile: The profile is invalid. Check required entities, explicit leaf targets, SleepyPod source settings, numeric ranges, and that the root light is not also a leaf. Then save again.

abort.already_configured: This stable profile ID is already configured.
